lines.text: John sees an open door in heaven, then a throne surrounded by twenty-four elders in white with golden crowns.
Before the throne are four living creatures, each with six wings, covered with eyes, who never stop saying "Holy, Holy, Holy."
The twenty-four elders cast their golden crowns before the throne and say God is worthy because He created all things.
John sees a scroll sealed with seven seals, and an elder says the Lion of the tribe of Levi has triumphed.
The Lamb stands in the center of the throne, takes the scroll from the angel, and the elders fall down before Him.

wrong_details.true: the right hand of the One seated on the throne
